dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Standard concave curvature on the trailing edge with a smooth spline transition from the apex to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a moderate pixel radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 40-degree acute angle relative to the longitudinal axis of the dorsal ridge.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Visible convex arc curvature at the dorsal-anterior boundary of the cranium.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent white depigmented patch/scar located on the dorsal-anterior cranium near the blowhole region.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast dark saddle pigment patch extending from the dorsal fin base into the light lateral field.
